name: IO-117
note: Packet digipeater in a much higher orbit than most, with long passes. Needs a directional antenna and a digital setup.
amsatStatusSource: Not on the AMSAT status page satellite list (https://www.amsat.org/status/), checked 2026-10-19

profile.builtBy: Sapienza University of Rome (S5Lab) with ENEA and the University of Naples; now co-owned by AMSAT Italia
profile.launch: Vega-C maiden flight from Kourou, July 2022
profile.story: GreenCube was built to grow microgreens in orbit. Its rocket left it unusually high, about 6,000 km up, which made it the first ham radio satellite in a medium Earth orbit: its digipeater can link stations thousands of kilometres apart for long stretches.
